from pathlib import Path
import ast,csv,hashlib,json,math,os,sys,time
start=time.monotonic()
ROOT=Path('/home/userland/aswing')
OUT=Path('/tmp/openswing-isae-focus-20261025/saved-audit.json')
report_path=ROOT/'docs/validation/isae-sa6-current.json'
csv_path=ROOT/'docs/validation/isae-sa6-current.csv'
source_path=ROOT/'docs/validation/isae-sa6-sources.json'
old_path=ROOT/'docs/validation/isae-sa6.json'
reference_path=ROOT/'scripts/isae_sa6_reference.py'
def digest(p):
 h=hashlib.sha256()
 with Path(p).open('rb') as f:
  for b in iter(lambda:f.read(1048576),b''):h.update(b)
 return h.hexdigest()
inputs={str(p):dict(bytes=p.stat().st_size,sha256=digest(p)) for p in (report_path,csv_path,source_path,old_path,reference_path)}
R=json.loads(report_path.read_text());S=json.loads(source_path.read_text());OLD=json.loads(old_path.read_text())
checks=0;fail=[];category_counts={};numerical_max_abs=0.;numerical_max_ulp=0.
def check(label,ok,category='structural',**detail):
 global checks
 checks+=1;category_counts[category]=category_counts.get(category,0)+1
 if not ok:fail.append(dict(name=label,category=category,**detail))
def same(label,a,b,category='exact'):
 check(label,a==b,category,actual=a,expected=b)
def near(label,a,b,category='statistics'):
 global numerical_max_abs,numerical_max_ulp
 a,b=float(a),float(b)
 allowed=64*math.ulp(max(abs(a),abs(b)))
 err=abs(a-b)
 numerical_max_abs=max(numerical_max_abs,err)
 ulps=err/math.ulp(max(abs(a),abs(b)))
 numerical_max_ulp=max(numerical_max_ulp,ulps)
 check(label,math.isfinite(a) and math.isfinite(b) and err<=allowed,category,actual=a,expected=b,error=err,allowed_64_ulp=allowed)
def stat(x):
 return dict(count=len(x),bias=math.fsum(x)/len(x),
  rmse=math.sqrt(math.fsum(v*v for v in x)/len(x)),maximum_absolute_error=max(map(abs,x)))
def compare_stat(label,a,b):
 same(label+' count',a['count'],b['count'])
 for k in ('bias','rmse','maximum_absolute_error'):near(label+' '+k,a[k],b[k])
# Extract only literal primary data assignments from the source AST; import no module.
literals={}
for node in ast.parse(reference_path.read_text()).body:
 if isinstance(node,ast.Assign):
  for target in node.targets:
   if isinstance(target,ast.Name) and target.id in ('IDS','TABLES'):literals[target.id]=ast.literal_eval(node.value)
ids=literals['IDS'];primary={}
for angle,text in literals['TABLES'].items():
 lines=text.splitlines();same('seven literal series '+str(angle),len(lines),7)
 for ident,line in zip(ids,lines):
  roll,yaw=[[int(v)*1e-4 for v in part.split()] for part in line.split('/')]
  same('eleven printed roll '+ident+str(angle),len(roll),11)
  same('eleven printed yaw '+ident+str(angle),len(yaw),11)
  for i,(cl,cn) in enumerate(zip(roll,yaw),1):primary[ident,angle,4*i]={'Cl':cl,'Cn':cn*25/60}
  primary[ident,angle,0]={'Cl':0.,'Cn':0.}
for ref in S['primary']:
 for i,d in enumerate(ref['delta']):
  for c,field in (('Cl','Cl_body'),('Cn','Cn_body')):
   same('source primary '+ref['id']+str(ref['body_alpha'])+str(d)+c,ref[field][i],primary[ref['id'],ref['body_alpha'],d][c],'primary_literal')
P=R['plan']
for path,want in P['source_sha256'].items():
 same('plan pin '+path,digest(ROOT/path),want,'source_pin')
same('110 current kernels',sum(p.startswith('openswing/') for p in P['source_sha256']),110)
same('source-derived plan identity',hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(P,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest(),R['identity'])
CACHE=ROOT/'.reference/isae-validation'/S['revision']
for path,want in S['sources'].items():
 p=CACHE/path
 same('raw input pin '+path,digest(p),want['sha256'],'raw_source_pin')
 same('raw input bytes '+path,p.stat().st_size,want['bytes'],'raw_source_pin')
for p in S['primary_manifest']:
 path=ROOT/'.reference/isae-sa6'/('naca-tr-'+str(p['report'])+'.pdf')
 same('primary PDF '+str(p['report']),digest(path),p['sha256'],'primary_pin')
same('fixed mesh grid',P['meshes'],[80,160])
same('fixed pitch grid',P['body_pitch_deg'],[0,8,12])
same('fixed delta grid',P['physical_deflection_deg'],list(range(0,45,4)))
same('current influences only',P['current_influences'],True)
same('no experimental threshold',P['experimental_acceptance_threshold'],None)
rows=R['cases'];lookup={};cache_count=0
cache=ROOT/'.reference/isae-sa6-current'/R['identity']
for row in rows:
 s=row['specification'];k=(s['case'],s['panels'],s['alpha'],s['delta'])
 check('unique row '+str(k),k not in lookup);lookup[k]=row
 ident=s['case'].removesuffix('_literal').removesuffix('_reconstructed')
 same('case id '+str(k),s['case'],ident+('_reconstructed' if ident=='10b_25c' else '_literal'))
 same('reconstruction '+str(k),s['reconstructed'],ident=='10b_25c')
 same('live influences '+str(k),s['frozen'],False)
 same('row identity '+str(k),row['identity'],R['identity'])
 same('status '+str(k),row['status'],'computed')
 same('observation kind '+str(k),row['reference_kind'],'symmetry_anchor' if s['delta']==0 else 'primary_tabulated')
 for c in ('Cl','Cn'):same('primary row '+str(k)+c,row['primary'][c],primary[ident,s['alpha'],s['delta']][c],'primary_literal')
 check('original residual '+str(k),row['result']['residual']<P['maximum_full_residual'],'original_gate')
 check('original wrench '+str(k),row['result']['independent_wrench_error']<P['maximum_wrench_error'],'original_gate')
 key=hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(s,sort_keys=True).encode()).hexdigest()
 saved=json.loads((cache/(key+'.json')).read_text())
 for field in ('status','result','specification','identity','seconds'):same('cache '+str(k)+' '+field,row[field],saved[field],'raw_cache')
 cache_count+=1
 for c in ('Cl','Cn','CL','CD','Cm'):check('finite '+str(k)+c,math.isfinite(row['result'][c]),'finite')
same('rows504',len(rows),504)
same('unique504',len(lookup),504)
expected_keys={(i+('_reconstructed' if i=='10b_25c' else '_literal'),n,a,d) for i in ids for n in (80,160) for a in (0,8,12) for d in range(0,45,4)}
same('complete grid',set(lookup),expected_keys)
same('accounting',R['accounting'],dict(requested=504,completed=504,rejected=0,newly_computed=504,reused=0,unique_tabulated_locations=231,tabulated_coefficients=462,unique_added_symmetry_anchors=21))
series=[];mesh_results=[];anchors=[];maxima={c:None for c in ('Cl','Cn')}
for claim in R['comparisons']:
 case,a=claim['case'],claim['body_pitch_deg']
 fine=[lookup[case,160,a,d] for d in range(4,45,4)]
 zero=lookup[case,160,a,0]
 same('11 requested '+case+str(a),claim['requested_measured'],11)
 same('11 completed '+case+str(a),claim['completed_measured'],11)
 out=dict(case=case,body_pitch_deg=a,measured={})
 for c in ('Cl','Cn'):
  errors=[r['result'][c]-r['primary'][c] for r in fine];st=stat(errors)
  compare_stat(case+str(a)+c+' measured',st,claim['measured_errors'][c])
  compare_stat(case+str(a)+c+' including anchor',stat([zero['result'][c]]+errors),claim['historical_style_including_anchor_errors'][c])
  ix=max(range(11),key=lambda i:abs(errors[i]));rr=fine[ix]
  out['measured'][c]=dict(**st,maximum=dict(deflection_deg=rr['specification']['delta'],predicted=rr['result'][c],observed=rr['primary'][c],signed_error=errors[ix]))
  if maxima[c] is None or abs(errors[ix])>abs(maxima[c]['signed_error']):maxima[c]=dict(case=case,body_pitch_deg=a,**out['measured'][c]['maximum'])
 series.append(out)
 anchors.append(dict(case=case,body_pitch_deg=a,fine_Cl=zero['result']['Cl'],fine_Cn=zero['result']['Cn'],role='appended zero anchors excluded from measured metrics'))
for claim in R['mesh_comparisons']:
 case,a=claim['case'],claim['body_pitch_deg']
 same('mesh completed '+case+str(a),claim['completed'],12)
 out=dict(case=case,body_pitch_deg=a,coarse_minus_fine={},measured_only={})
 for c in ('Cl','Cn'):
  errors=[lookup[case,80,a,d]['result'][c]-lookup[case,160,a,d]['result'][c] for d in range(0,45,4)]
  st=stat(errors);compare_stat(case+str(a)+c+' mesh',st,claim['difference'][c])
  ix=max(range(12),key=lambda i:abs(errors[i]))
  out['coarse_minus_fine'][c]=dict(**st,maximum_deflection_deg=4*ix,signed_error_at_maximum=errors[ix])
  out['measured_only'][c]=stat(errors[1:])
 mesh_results.append(out)
same('21 primary series',len(series),21)
same('21 mesh series',len(mesh_results),21)
historical_lookup={}
for case in OLD['cases']:
 for row in case['runs']:
  s=row['specification']
  if not s['frozen']:historical_lookup[case['case_id'],s['panels'],s['alpha'],s['delta']]=row
history_max={c:dict(absolute_difference=-1) for c in ('Cl','Cn','CL','CD','Cm')}
for claim in R['historical_differences']:
 k=(claim['case'],claim['panels'],claim['body_pitch_deg'],claim['deflection_deg'])
 for c in history_max:
  diff=lookup[k]['result'][c]-historical_lookup[k]['result'][c]
  same('historical '+str(k)+c,diff,claim['difference'][c],'historical_difference')
  if abs(diff)>history_max[c]['absolute_difference']:history_max[c]=dict(absolute_difference=abs(diff),signed_difference=diff,case=k[0],panels=k[1],body_pitch_deg=k[2],deflection_deg=k[3])
same('504 historical rows',len(R['historical_differences']),504)
csv_rows=list(csv.DictReader(csv_path.open()))
same('504 CSV rows',len(csv_rows),504)
for line,row in enumerate(csv_rows,2):
 k=(row['case'],int(row['panels']),int(row['body_pitch_deg']),int(row['deflection_deg']))
 rr=lookup[k]
 for field in ('status','reference_kind'):same('CSV '+str(line)+field,row[field],rr[field],'csv')
 for c in ('Cl','Cn'):
  for field,want in ((c,rr['result'][c]),(c+'_measured',rr['primary'][c]),(c+'_error',rr['result'][c]-rr['primary'][c])):
   same('CSV '+str(line)+field,float(row[field]),want,'csv')
observed_max_residual=max(r['result']['residual'] for r in rows)
observed_max_wrench=max(r['result']['independent_wrench_error'] for r in rows)
zero_max=max(abs(r['result'][c]) for r in rows if r['specification']['delta']==0 for c in ('Cl','Cn'))
same('maximum residual',observed_max_residual,R['maximum_residual'])
same('maximum wrench',observed_max_wrench,R['maximum_wrench_error'])
same('anchor maximum',zero_max,R['maximum_zero_control_lateral_moment'])
for path,want in inputs.items():same('final input pin '+path,digest(path),want['sha256'],'final_pin')
same('no production imports',any(k=='openswing' or k.startswith('openswing.') for k in sys.modules),False)
